method: Each request generates a whole strip; seed B attached on every call; revisions regenerate whole strip.

generations.prompt: Edit the padded SIX-slot layout into ONE WHOLE SPRITE ANIMATION STRIP, EXACTLY SIX full-body poses in ONE HORIZONTAL ROW, equal slots. Reference1 is approved Valdrakk seed; reference2 six-slot layout. SAME exact model/materials/lighting every frame: four-legged violet crystal behemoth with gold thorn trim, EXACTLY FOUR legs with gold claws, TWO tall upright crystal wings (near and far wing), ONE tail curled UP on RIGHT with cyan tip, ONE circular cyan core on near/anatomical LEFT shoulder, cyan eyes. Facing LEFT three-quarter, NEVER mirror core. Keep head and shoulder core visible. Strict SAME TORSO LENGTH (shoulder core to rear hip, excluding wings/tail) and head/limb proportions in all six; do not scale up/down any pose, do not enlarge beyond seed. Move SHARD TALON: 1 exact seed ready; 2 lift FRONT-RIGHT paw (far-side front leg, on VIEWER LEFT) HIGH off ground and cock it backward near chest, head still visible, other three feet planted, torso shifts back a little; 3 rear knees crouch, chest leans forward aiming low, raised same paw drawn ready, same rigid torso length; 4 same raised FRONT-RIGHT paw swipes DOWN toward LEFT, gold claws contact ground LOW LEFT close to toes, compact foreshortened reach entirely within slot; 5 low forward follow-through, same paw low left relaxing, other three legs clear; 6 exact seed ready. Exactly TWO front paws and TWO rear paws in EACH pose, separate all four legs/feet so countable, no human arms. Wings stay raised/folded close to back, never spread horizontally, wing tops no more than modestly above seed crown height. Same planted-foot baseline, full body/cyan-tail tip/wing tips visible with large margins. AT LEAST100px completely empty ALPHA0 gaps between silhouettes, no alpha haze in gaps, outer margin32px, six figures together not two rows. True transparent background, NO floor/shadow plate, NO wind/dust/light beams/shockwaves/detached shards/VFX, no text/letters/UI/logos.

No dome obscuring face/core, wings do NOT become extra legs or a blanket covering the head. Wings always upright/folded, never horizontally spread. Keep same scale in every pose, lower stance by leg bend not shrinking torso. Same ground line. Full wing/paw/tail tips inside own slots, wide EMPTY alpha gutters >=110px and outside margins, no overlap or clipping. Exactly six figures in one row. Transparent background true alpha, no floor/shadow plate, no glowing cloud/energy ball/wind/dust/beams/shockwave/detached shards/VFX, no text/numbers/UI.
